description: Defines the FooTable.Row class, representing a row in a FooTable, including methods for creation, data management, expansion/collapse, and rendering.

classes.name: FooTable.Row
classes.description: Represents a row in a FooTable, managing its cells, styles, expansion state, and interactions.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes a FooTable.Row instance with table, columns, and data or element.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines row data and properties from an object or DOM element.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for the row and initializes its cells and event handlers.

methods.name: createCells
methods.description: Creates cell objects for the row based on column definitions.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the row's data object.

methods.name: _setClasses
methods.description: Applies CSS classes to the row element.

methods.name: _setStyle
methods.description: Applies inline styles to the row element.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the row to show hidden columns in a detail row.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the row, hiding the detail row.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Prepares the row for redrawing, detaching details and toggle elements.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the row and its cells into the DOM.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the row between expanded and collapsed states.

methods.name: _onToggle
methods.description: Handles click events on the toggle element to expand/collapse the row.
